protocol.info: Exact geometry is privileged state. Native ONNX gait is fixed. Full-route V19 task predicates stay unchanged.

pretraining_interruption.cause: Unhydrated sibling function imported into serialized orchestrator; fixed by deployed-name lookup. Conservative prior budget reservations carried forward.

protocol.research_query: mobile robot navigation final pose alignment oscillation phase switching hysteresis goal heading tolerance
protocol.research_question: Can separating travel and final-heading alignment prevent observed phase chatter without relaxing pose or contact constraints?
protocol.research_hypothesis: Phase hysteresis can remove a controller defect. After sharing that repair across controls, geometry-aware route selection may still improve physical efficiency; that incremental claim requires new measurements.
protocol.controller_revision: alignment-r1: latch final-heading phase, position-valid dwell, bounded local correction
protocol.budget_amendment: One optimizer update from the interrupted controller-feasibility probe remains charged and unpromoted. The new comparison may perform at most fifteen more, preserving the original sixteen-update total ceiling. All used training layouts and unlabelled failures are retained.
protocol.unlabelled_training_rule: Retain every physically failed candidate set. If all three fail, record no supervised label and continue to the next pre-generated training layout without an optimizer update. Save and evaluate the actual endpoint if bounded data is exhausted before fifteen updates.

source_freeze.scope: Source and configs before any navigation Tinker optimizer update; excluded self-referential manifest. Physics and decision contracts frozen for comparisons.
source_freeze.revision: c: alignment repair, strict implementation of existing dwell tolerance, per-case memory reader isolation; all controls rerun before any final opening

public_summary: 15 real Tinker optimizer updates. On eight unseen layouts with two physics seeds each, parent and selected qualification were 14/16 and 14/16; the strongest fixed strategy qualified 16/16. Training changed 1 final route choice. Geometry is privileged and the native gait is fixed.
memory_summary: The selected weights qualified 14/16 without retrieval and 14/16 with frozen training-memory retrieval. Three-attempt adaptation is reported separately in the full evidence. This does not by itself establish a memory benefit. In the separate eight-layout, one-seed adaptation comparison, success within three attempts was 7/8 without retrieval and 7/8 with retrieval, using 10 and 10 total attempts. Both conditions retained their local failure history.
